squircle.summary: A shape pattern for continuous rounded corners: sets a radius, then refines it with `corner-shape` where supported, so every browser renders at least the plain rounded shape.

width.name: width
width.description:
Applies the physical `width` property, for an element whose sizing is tied
to the physical viewport axis; `u.is()` (`inline-size`) covers sizing along
the logical inline axis.
width.summary: Applies the physical `width` property, for an element whose sizing is tied to the physical viewport axis; `u.is()` (`inline-size`) covers sizing along the logical inline axis.

backdropBlur.name: backdropBlur
backdropBlur.description:
Blurs the backdrop by a step from the blur scale, whatever the user's
transparency preference; `u.translucent()` is the gated variant with a solid
fallback. Sibling utilities combine through the shared composite filter.
backdropBlur.summary: Blurs the backdrop by a step from the blur scale, whatever the user's transparency preference; `u.translucent()` is the gated variant with a solid fallback.

backdropBrightness.name: backdropBrightness
backdropBrightness.summary: Scales the backdrop's lightness — below `1` darkens, above `1` brightens — keeping overlaid text legible.

backdropContrast.name: backdropContrast
backdropContrast.summary: Pushes the backdrop away from (above `1`) or toward (below `1`) mid-grey; flattening it to a uniform tone keeps overlaid text legible.

backdropDropShadow.name: backdropDropShadow
backdropDropShadow.description:
Shadows the rendered shape of whatever shows through the host — a subtle
depth cue behind a translucent panel, where `u.shadow()` and `u.dropShadow()`
cover the element's own box. `u.transparencySafe()` gates it.
backdropDropShadow.summary: Shadows the rendered shape of whatever shows through the host — a subtle depth cue behind a translucent panel, where `u.shadow()` and `u.dropShadow()` cover the element's own box.

examples.output: css({ "--ui-backdrop-drop-shadow": "calc(var(--ui-spacing, 0.25rem) * 0) calc(var(--ui-spacing, 0.25rem) * 1) calc(var(--ui-spacing, 0.25rem) * 2) rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15)", backdropFilter: "... drop-shadow(var(--ui-backdrop-drop-shadow, 0 0 0 transparent))" })

backdropGrayscale.name: backdropGrayscale
backdropGrayscale.summary: Desaturates the backdrop toward grey (`1` fully, `0` untouched) so a coloured overlay reads as the only hue in the area.

backdropHueRotate.name: backdropHueRotate
backdropHueRotate.description:
Rotates the backdrop's hue while preserving lightness and saturation, so a
busy backdrop pulls toward one brand hue with its light/dark structure
intact. Needs a partly transparent host; `u.transparencySafe()` gates it.
backdropHueRotate.summary: Rotates the backdrop's hue while preserving lightness and saturation, so a busy backdrop pulls toward one brand hue with its light/dark structure intact.

backdropInvert.name: backdropInvert
backdropInvert.description:
Inverts the colours showing through the element's translucent background.
Composes with every other backdrop utility through the shared composite
`backdropFilter`; wrap in `u.transparencySafe()` for a solid fallback.
backdropInvert.summary: Inverts the colours showing through the element's translucent background.

backdropOpacity.name: backdropOpacity
backdropOpacity.description:
Fades what shows through the element's translucent background, taking CSS's
native `0`–`1` range or a percentage string. Composes with every other
backdrop utility; wrap in `u.transparencySafe()` for a solid fallback.
backdropOpacity.summary: Fades what shows through the element's translucent background, taking CSS's native `0`–`1` range or a percentage string.

backdropSaturate.name: backdropSaturate
backdropSaturate.description:
Boosts or mutes the saturation of what shows through the element's
translucent background. Composes with every other backdrop utility; wrap in
`u.transparencySafe()` for a solid fallback.
backdropSaturate.summary: Boosts or mutes the saturation of what shows through the element's translucent background.

backdropSepia.name: backdropSepia
backdropSepia.description:
Shifts what shows through the element's translucent background toward a warm
brown monochrome. Composes with every other backdrop utility; wrap in
`u.transparencySafe()` for a solid fallback.
backdropSepia.summary: Shifts what shows through the element's translucent background toward a warm brown monochrome.

backfaceVisibility.name: backfaceVisibility
backfaceVisibility.description:
Controls whether the back face of a 3D-transformed element renders once it
rotates away from the viewer; the `"hidden"` default keeps flip-card and
page-turn effects showing only their front face.
backfaceVisibility.summary: Controls whether the back face of a 3D-transformed element renders once it rotates away from the viewer; the `"hidden"` default keeps flip-card and page-turn effects showing only their front face.

blur.name: blur
blur.description:
Applies a blur from the blur scale by writing only its own
`--ui-filter-blur` custom property, so it combines with `u.grayscale()`,
`u.brightness()`, and every other filter utility in one composite `filter`.
blur.summary: Applies a blur from the blur scale by writing only its own `--ui-filter-blur` custom property, so it combines with `u.grayscale()`, `u.brightness()`, and every other filter utility in one composite `filter`.

brightness.name: brightness
brightness.description:
Applies a `filter: brightness(...)`, scaling every pixel's lightness. Values
below `1` darken and above `1` brighten; `0` is solid black. Composes with
every other filter utility through the shared composite `filter`.
brightness.summary: Applies a `filter: brightness(...)`, scaling every pixel's lightness.

contrast.name: contrast
contrast.description:
Applies a `filter: contrast(...)`, pushing pixels away from (above `1`) or
toward (below `1`) mid-grey; `0` flattens the element to uniform grey.
Composes with every other filter utility through the shared composite filter.
contrast.summary: Applies a `filter: contrast(...)`, pushing pixels away from (above `1`) or toward (below `1`) mid-grey; `0` flattens the element to uniform grey.

dropShadow.name: dropShadow
dropShadow.description:
Applies `filter: drop-shadow(...)`, shadowing the element's rendered shape — a
PNG's alpha channel, an SVG icon's outline — with offsets and a blur radius.
Composes with every filter utility through the shared composite `filter`.
dropShadow.summary: Applies `filter: drop-shadow(...)`, shadowing the element's rendered shape — a PNG's alpha channel, an SVG icon's outline — with offsets and a blur radius.

examples.output: css({ "--ui-filter-drop-shadow": "calc(var(--ui-spacing, 0.25rem) * 0) calc(var(--ui-spacing, 0.25rem) * 1) calc(var(--ui-spacing, 0.25rem) * 2) rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15)", filter: "... drop-shadow(var(--ui-filter-drop-shadow, 0 0 0 transparent))" })

filterOpacity.name: filterOpacity
filterOpacity.description:
Applies a `filter: opacity(...)`, fading the element inside the filter
pipeline so one pass carries the fade along with any `blur()` or
`grayscale()`. Takes CSS's native `0`–`1` range, or a percentage string.
filterOpacity.summary: Applies a `filter: opacity(...)`, fading the element inside the filter pipeline so one pass carries the fade along with any `blur()` or `grayscale()`.

grayscale.name: grayscale
grayscale.description:
Applies a `filter: grayscale(...)`, desaturating toward grey; `1` (the
default) is fully grey, dimming an inactive element while its layout holds.
Purely visual, so pair it with a cue assistive technology can read.
grayscale.summary: Applies a `filter: grayscale(...)`, desaturating toward grey; `1` (the default) is fully grey, dimming an inactive element while its layout holds.

hueRotate.name: hueRotate
hueRotate.description:
Applies a `filter: hue-rotate(...)`, rotating every pixel's hue by the given
angle while preserving lightness and saturation, so one source asset can be
retinted per theme. A bare number is degrees; strings pass through as-is.
hueRotate.summary: Applies a `filter: hue-rotate(...)`, rotating every pixel's hue by the given angle while preserving lightness and saturation, so one source asset can be retinted per theme.

invert.name: invert
invert.summary: Inverts colors (`1`, the default, fully) to flip single-color raster assets for dark mode.

mask.name: mask
mask.description:
Applies a CSS mask image, or the given subset of mask properties when
passed an options object. Every property is mirrored onto its `-webkit-`
prefixed twin, which Safari requires to render an element mask.
mask.summary: Applies a CSS mask image, or the given subset of mask properties when passed an options object.

examples.output: css({ maskImage: "linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, black)", WebkitMaskImage: "linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, black)" })

css({ maskImage: "url(/badge.png)", WebkitMaskImage: "url(/badge.png)", maskSize: "contain", WebkitMaskSize: "contain", maskPosition: "center", WebkitMaskPosition: "center", maskRepeat: "no-repeat", WebkitMaskRepeat: "no-repeat" })

mixBlendMode.name: mixBlendMode
mixBlendMode.description:
Blends the element with the content painted behind it. Any value but
`normal` makes the element its own stacking context, and blending stops at
the nearest one — put `u.isolate()` on the ancestor that should bound it.
mixBlendMode.summary: Blends the element with the content painted behind it.

opacity.name: opacity
opacity.description:
Applies opacity from a 0-100 integer. Sets the `opacity` property, which
flattens the element and all of its descendants into one group and fades
that group as a whole.

ringShadow.name: ringShadow
ringShadow.description:
Draws a selection ring that stays visible for as long as a component applies
it, for persistently-selected swatches, chips, and thumbnails. Occupies the
composite `boxShadow` `ring` slot, painting inside `u.shadow()`'s elevation.
ringShadow.summary: Draws a selection ring that stays visible for as long as a component applies it, for persistently-selected swatches, chips, and thumbnails.

rounded.name: rounded
rounded.description: Applies a corner radius from the radius scale or a raw CSS length.
rounded.summary: Applies a corner radius from the radius scale or a raw CSS length.

roundedCorner.name: roundedCorner
roundedCorner.description:
Applies a radius from the radius scale, or a raw CSS length, to one logical
corner — for shapes that round three corners uniformly and differentiate
the fourth, like a chat bubble's tail.
roundedCorner.summary: Applies a radius from the radius scale, or a raw CSS length, to one logical corner — for shapes that round three corners uniformly and differentiate the fourth, like a chat bubble's tail.

saturate.name: saturate
saturate.description:
Applies a `filter: saturate(...)` to the element itself, where `0` is fully
desaturated and values above `1` oversaturate. Writes into the shared
composite `filter` declaration, so it stacks with every other filter utility.
saturate.summary: Applies a `filter: saturate(...)` to the element itself, where `0` is fully desaturated and values above `1` oversaturate.

sepia.name: sepia
sepia.description:
Applies a `filter: sepia(...)`, shifting the element toward a warm brown
monochrome; `1` (the default) is a full conversion. Writes into the shared
composite `filter` declaration, so it stacks with every other filter utility.
sepia.summary: Applies a `filter: sepia(...)`, shifting the element toward a warm brown monochrome; `1` (the default) is a full conversion.

shadow.name: shadow
shadow.description:
Applies a box shadow from the shadow scale, written to the `elevation` slot
of the shared composite `boxShadow` declaration. Claiming only that slot lets
an elevation shadow and a `u.ringShadow()` render as two stacked layers.
shadow.summary: Applies a box shadow from the shadow scale, written to the `elevation` slot of the shared composite `boxShadow` declaration.

textShadow.name: textShadow
textShadow.description:
Applies `text-shadow`, tracing the glyph forms themselves. The practical use
is keeping text legible over an image or video; a translucent scrim between
the media and the text stays the reliable fix, with this layered on top.
textShadow.summary: Applies `text-shadow`, tracing the glyph forms themselves.

transition.name: transition
transition.description:
Applies the `transition-property`/`transition-timing-function`/
`transition-duration` triplet behind most hover, focus, press and selection
state changes, so a call site only names which properties animate.
transition.summary: Applies the `transition-property`/`transition-timing-function`/ `transition-duration` triplet behind most hover, focus, press and selection state changes, so a call site only names which properties animate.

transitionBehavior.name: transitionBehavior
transitionBehavior.description:
Applies the `transition-behavior` property on its own; `"allow-discrete"`
lets a discrete property such as `display` or `content-visibility` animate
across a transition, commonly paired with `@starting-style`.
transitionBehavior.summary: Applies the `transition-behavior` property on its own; `"allow-discrete"` lets a discrete property such as `display` or `content-visibility` animate across a transition, commonly paired with `@starting-style`.

transitionDelay.name: transitionDelay
transitionDelay.description:
Applies `transition-delay` on its own, so items sharing one transition can
stagger by giving each an increasing delay. Keep the stagger on the entering
state and leave the leaving state at `0s`, so dismissal stays immediate.
transitionDelay.summary: Applies `transition-delay` on its own, so items sharing one transition can stagger by giving each an increasing delay.

transitionDuration.name: transitionDuration
transitionDuration.description:
Applies `transition-duration` on its own, so a media query such as
`prefers-reduced-motion` can shrink an already-declared transition to zero
while its property list and timing function stay in place.
transitionDuration.summary: Applies `transition-duration` on its own, so a media query such as `prefers-reduced-motion` can shrink an already-declared transition to zero while its property list and timing function stay in place.

transitionProperty.name: transitionProperty
transitionProperty.description:
Applies `transition-property` on its own, so a variant can change which
properties animate while the duration and timing function declared
elsewhere stay in place.
transitionProperty.summary: Applies `transition-property` on its own, so a variant can change which properties animate while the duration and timing function declared elsewhere stay in place.

visibility.name: visibility
visibility.description:
Controls the CSS `visibility` property: a `"hidden"` element keeps its
layout box and can transition back to `"visible"`, which is what a
selection indicator or hover-triggered surface needs to fade in place.
visibility.summary: Controls the CSS `visibility` property: a `"hidden"` element keeps its layout box and can transition back to `"visible"`, which is what a selection indicator or hover-triggered surface needs to fade in place.

perspective.name: perspective
perspective.description:
Sets how far the viewer is from the z=0 plane; without it, 3D rotation
reads as a flat scale, not depth. Goes on the **parent**, alongside
`u.transformStyle()`, as its own CSS property outside the composed `transform`.
perspective.summary: Sets how far the viewer is from the z=0 plane; without it, 3D rotation reads as a flat scale, not depth.

perspectiveOrigin.name: perspectiveOrigin
perspectiveOrigin.description:
Moves the vanishing point that `u.perspective()` establishes, aiming the
3D effect off-centre; set it on the same parent element that carries
`u.perspective()`.
perspectiveOrigin.summary: Moves the vanishing point that `u.perspective()` establishes, aiming the 3D effect off-centre; set it on the same parent element that carries `u.perspective()`.

rotate.name: rotate
rotate.description:
Rotates the element in its own 2D plane. A bare number is treated as
degrees; a string passes through unchanged (e.g. `"0.25turn"`).
Composable with every other `transform/` utility.
rotate.summary: Rotates the element in its own 2D plane.

rotateX.name: rotateX
rotateX.description:
Rotates the element in 3D around its horizontal axis for a flip-card or
page-turn effect. Pair with `u.backfaceVisibility()` to keep the reversed
face hidden mid-rotation, and compose freely with other `transform/` utilities.
rotateX.summary: Rotates the element in 3D around its horizontal axis for a flip-card or page-turn effect.

rotateY.name: rotateY
rotateY.description:
Rotates the element in 3D around its vertical axis — a flip-card or
page-turn effect. Pair with `u.backfaceVisibility()` to hide the reversed
face mid-rotation. Composable with every other `transform/` utility.
rotateY.summary: Rotates the element in 3D around its vertical axis — a flip-card or page-turn effect.

scale.name: scale
scale.description:
Scales the element uniformly on both axes — sugar for setting `u.scaleX()`
and `u.scaleY()` to the same factor in one call. Composable with every
other `transform/` utility.
scale.summary: Scales the element uniformly on both axes — sugar for setting `u.scaleX()` and `u.scaleY()` to the same factor in one call.

scaleProperty.name: scaleProperty
scaleProperty.description:
Sets the standalone `scale` CSS property directly — distinct from
`u.scale()`, which sets the `scale(...)` transform function through the
composable `transform` mechanism; overwrites outright, matching its use.
scaleProperty.summary: Sets the standalone `scale` CSS property directly — distinct from `u.scale()`, which sets the `scale(...)` transform function through the composable `transform` mechanism; overwrites outright, matching its use.

scaleX.name: scaleX
scaleX.description:
Scales the element along the horizontal axis only. A bare number is a
unitless factor (`1` is unchanged, `1.5` is 150%); a string passes
through unchanged. Composable with every other `transform/` utility.
scaleX.summary: Scales the element along the horizontal axis only.

scaleY.name: scaleY
scaleY.description:
Scales the element along the vertical axis only. A bare number is a
unitless factor; a string passes through unchanged. Composable with
every other `transform/` utility.
scaleY.summary: Scales the element along the vertical axis only.

skewX.name: skewX
skewX.description:
Skews the element along the horizontal axis. A bare number is treated as
degrees; a string passes through unchanged. Composable with every other
`transform/` utility.
skewX.summary: Skews the element along the horizontal axis.

skewY.name: skewY
skewY.description:
Skews the element along the vertical axis. A bare number is treated as
degrees; a string passes through unchanged. Composable with every other
`transform/` utility.
skewY.summary: Skews the element along the vertical axis.

transformOrigin.name: transformOrigin
transformOrigin.description:
Sets the pivot point for every transform on the element. It's its own CSS
property, set outright rather than joining the additive `transform`
composition. Values are physical only — drive an RTL-flipping origin from a custom property.
transformOrigin.summary: Sets the pivot point for every transform on the element.

transformStyle.name: transformStyle
transformStyle.description:
Sets the standalone `transform-style` property outright on the **parent** of
3D-transformed children, since CSS defaults to `flat`; an `overflow`, `filter`,
`mask`, or opacity below 1 on the element silently forces it back to `flat`.
transformStyle.summary: Sets the standalone `transform-style` property outright on the **parent** of 3D-transformed children, since CSS defaults to `flat`; an `overflow`, `filter`, `mask`, or opacity below 1 on the element silently forces it back to `flat`.

translateProperty.name: translateProperty
translateProperty.description:
Sets the standalone `translate` property outright, since at most one
value is ever active at a time. Accepts raw CSS shorthand — offsets or a
keyword like `none` — for percentages and multi-axis values.
translateProperty.summary: Sets the standalone `translate` property outright, since at most one value is ever active at a time.

translateX.name: translateX
translateX.description:
Translates the element along the inline axis using the spacing scale or a
raw CSS length. Composes with every other `transform/` utility, so
`u.translateX()` combined with `u.rotate()` applies both.
translateX.summary: Translates the element along the inline axis using the spacing scale or a raw CSS length.

translateY.name: translateY
translateY.description:
Translates the element along the block axis using the spacing scale or a
raw CSS length. Composable with every other `transform/` utility.
translateY.summary: Translates the element along the block axis using the spacing scale or a raw CSS length.
